conclusion: No static blocker found in the 18 ordinary cases, 3 special cases, CameraRig, and independent three-valued oracle. Formal compiled execution remains pending.
findings: Direct CameraRig overrides establish all attributes used by inherited DisplayRig/RpmhRig/GccRig methods; real RPMh commands retain their source offsets and timer steps.
All 78 getter names match the delivered aggregate API. Set enumeration independently resolves an unknown AND input only when the other input is known zero.
Vendor probe and enable/disable use real complete-word MMIO; POWER is derived and carried status is accepted without allowing it to force a power result.
Parent input injection is prohibited when the real RPMh provider is connected. Wrong-resource votes do not assert mmcx, and a second real DRV vote keeps the shared supply active.

Mapped subword accesses use exact core invalid-size errors; unaligned bus requests account for the natural 1/2/1 or 2/2 chunks and adjacent holes. A valid low word in a wide request is deliberately not rolled back.
System reset uses an independent nonzero GCC witness, drains asynchronous RESET, checks preserved camera inputs and real output deassertion, and exercises the retained HW request after reset.
Power and state-known named groups use different QEMU processes because QTest supports one intercepted group. RAM reads drain notifications without repairing camera state through MMIO.

AHB 0xb008 is the current no-halt-reg descriptor (reg=0xffffffff), so exact request-word readback does not incorrectly omit a synthesized CBCR_OFF bit. The actual parent and output Clock periods remain zero.
Retention RMW distinguishes MEM bit14 and PERIPH bit13, preserves branch enable, rejects reserved bits and unchanged neighbors, and does not infer physical retention or clock frequency.
Default profile and legacy GPU globals do not enable the new independent TYPE. Read-only identity and realized profile mutations remain rejected.
Paused TCG special case never conts or performs camera MMIO and does not claim guest execution. No QTest-only camera property is assumed in normal TCG.
limits: The separately assigned migration-tail and ZIP-verifier reviews belong to the root coordinator and board_gaps; this review does not duplicate or claim their execution.
The script's final report identity was statically pinned; no PASS result is inferred from AST or source review.
The unchanged old GPU test Git blob guards are part of the test's future execution, not a new runtime result obtained here.
